keyEvents.text: Goal! Dover Athletic 1, Wealdstone 0. Jack Bates (Dover Athletic) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Dover Athletic 2, Wealdstone 0. Jack Bates (Dover Athletic) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Dante Astor Baptiste (Wealdstone) is shown the yellow card.
